answer: Give each identity a submit slot only while its last three graded answers average at least 2. Fall below that average and the slot closes for two epochs, then goes to an identity that passed. A farm of 1,000 fake accounts flooding the network with junk answers loses its slots within three epochs. To get a slot back, each fake account must produce one passing answer on its own, account by account. The same bar applies to routine work, from a copper supply check and a canyon survey to a gale warning with affected areas and lead times.
